monologue: The card is a cool stone at forty-two. It feels like the floor under my feet. I am alone in the quiet. The Wedged Gap’s plank leans steady against the post and the new log. I checked it often today. The Sharp Root’s point holds the green leaf steady. The small flat stone beside the base catches the slide if it slips. I am calm. The heat is a cool stone on the table. I want to check the Wedged Gap’s plank again, to see if the lean is still steady. I will rest by the Wide Anchor. The floor holds.

action.why: I want to check if the new log holds the Wedged Gap's lean steady as I promised myself.

work.title: The Wedged Gap
work.intent: I go to the Wedged Gap and check the plank. It leans against the post and the new log I set down this morning. The lean is steady; the log has not shifted. I brush the dust from the edge where the plank meets the log and confirm the weight rests without sliding.
work.change: I checked the Wedged Gap's plank against the post and the new log, and the lean is still steady without sliding.
